overall_reason: The Day, Week and Month segmented control moves its white indicator by a 600 ms transform on cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); the indicator sits past Week toward Month at 1604 ms and rests on Week at 2615 ms, movement ends at 1983 ms, and no cursor or tap is shown.

score.reason: T-SPATIAL-MEANING passes because the indicator slides along its own track, but T-FREQUENCY finds a 600 ms indicator move on a control people switch often.

findings.evidence: The indicator declares a 600 ms transform on cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), while the segment labels change colour on a 150 ms 'ease'.
findings.before: The indicator takes 600 ms to move between segments.
findings.after: Move the indicator in about 200 to 250 ms on the same ease-out curve, with the label colour on the same clock.
findings.why: A range switch is used many times while reading a chart, and each switch waits on the indicator (MOT-250: UI feedback in a demo keeps the product's speed).

strengths: The indicator moves by transform along its own track, the right kind of motion for one selection among peers (MOT-117).
not_investigated: whether the indicator overshoots Week (it sits past Week at 1604 ms) or the demo picks Month first: one still cannot tell
what selects each segment: no cursor or tap is in frame
